sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= '2026-10-30 20:47+00') AS snaps_since_resume, (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= '2026-10-30 20:47+00') AS mkts_since_resume, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS snaps_24h, (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS mkts_24h, (SELECT max(at) FROM incentive_market_snapshots) AS last_snap, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_trade_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-30 20:47+00') AS trades_since_resume, (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM incentive_trade_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-30 20:47+00') AS trade_mkts_since_resume, (SELECT max(received_at) FROM incentive_trade_events) AS last_trade, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type = 'liquidity') AS live_liq_programs, (SELECT round(sum(period_reward_usd)::numeric, 0) FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type = 'liquidity') AS live_pool_usd, (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM incentive_programs WHERE first_seen_at >= '2026-10-30 20:47+00') AS new_prog_mkts_since_resume, (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM incentive_market_snapshots) AS mkts_all_time, (SELECT min(at) FROM incentive_market_snapshots) AS first_snap
